msg: Do you carry oxygen on the boat in case of an emergency?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Yes, we carry oxygen and a first-aid kit on board. Our staff are trained, and we have an emergency protocol.

Tell me, what would you like to experience with us? 🤿
• *Diving* in the Rosario Islands, if you're already certified
• A beginner *mini-course* to try diving for the first time (no experience needed!)
• *Snorkeling* to enjoy the reef from the surface, great for families
• Full *PADI courses*, from Open Water up
Tell me what catches your eye and we'll put it together. 🌊
